main_text.p: & malo eidem afcribendo;{*} quorum sententiam amplexus est & Wasel Ebn Ata &c.Ad verbum, eorum licistorio texuit. Ibid.

Qua subjectum sunt Theologia Scholastica] Cur علم الكلام Theologiam Scholasticam reddamus primo in loco hic ratio reddenda est, quæ facilè patebit ex iis quæ de ejus origine & progressu tradit author modo laudatus, ثم طالع بعن ذلك شيوخ المعتزلة كتب الفلاسفة حين فشرت بايام المامون فخلطت مناهجها بمناهج الكلام وافردتها فنا من فنون العلم وسمتهما باسم الكلام اما لان اظهر مسلمة تكلموا فيها وقاتلوا عليها هي مسلمة الكلام فسمي النوع باسمها واما لمقابلتهم الفلاسفة في تسميتهم فسنا من فنون علمهم بالمنطق والمنطق Deinde inspexerant e Motazalorum doctis quidam libros Philosophorum cum imperante Mamone versi essent, & eorum vias cum viis {*} [scientiæ] AlCalam, miscuerunt, atque inde speciem scientiæ peculiarem constituerunt quam scientiam AlCalam nuncuparunt; vel quòd præcipua, de qua apud eos disputatur & controvertitur, quæstio sit illa de Sermone [seu verbo Dei] atque ita toti speciei nomen tribuitur; vel quòd imitati fuerint Philosophos qui speciem è speciebus scientiarum suarum (Logicam sc.) vocarunt AlMantek, sunt autem AlMantek & AlCalam Synonyma, quorum utrumq; sc. Loquelam, sive sermonem denotat. Ac certè minimè dubium est Semiphilosophos istos dum scientiæ suæ novorepertæ nomen imponerent, vocis λογικὴ Etymon, quo à λόγω verbum, sive sermonem denotante, deducitur atque differendi artem significat, forf. legend. الاسلام cum viis Islamismi.ficat,

page.notes: Faint stains and show-through over the text, especially in the upper right. The Arabic lines are blurred: the words are my best reading and several may be wrong; the Arabic in the first Arabic line after "علم" and the final Arabic words of the Arabic block are uncertain. The Greek words λογικὴ and λόγω are faint. The note "forf. legend." is printed as shown; the Arabic in it is copied with low confidence. The note marks "*" are printed; I have placed them as they stand in the text. The Cc 3 signature sits in the same line as the last word "ficat,".
